title: Cell Info Repository: battery-cell specifications as linked data (EMMO / JSON-LD) with a GraphRAG workflow
description:
This dataset contains the specifications of 382 battery cells as linked data. Each cell is a JSON-LD profile with the EMMO battery domain ontology (https://w3id.org/emmo/domain/battery/context). A profile gives rated capacity, voltage limits, currents, cycle life, mass, dimensions, case and cathode chemistry. Each value has a citation of its source. A profile also gives the DOIs of publications that use or mention the cell.

The repository also contains:

  • batterygraph: a Python package. It loads the profiles into an RDF graph. It answers questions about the cells with graph queries that an LLM writes (GraphRAG).
  • 300 questions with reference answers, the results of an earlier evaluation and a logged evaluation of current LLMs with and without the knowledge graph.
  • An agentic literature review of 2025 gold and diamond open-access papers (LLM wiki).
